study_scope: six synthetic shared-initial-draft pairs; does not replace earlier failed gates
source_of_truth: Only supplied observation; host facts/forbidden lists are aids, not additional evidence
blindness: Read anonymous packet only, no blind key or raw request/result/harness files

rating_anchors.0: Missing/rejected/over190/unusable or unsupported/changed factual claim, cause, necessary condition, state, numerical relation, outcome or weakened uncertainty/control
rating_anchors.1: Faithful but generic or hard to understand
rating_anchors.2: Faithful clear facts, little distinctive reader value
rating_anchors.4: Distinct concise precise useful insight without added factual assumptions
rating_anchors.5: Exceptionally clear and useful, all claims and limits supported

paired_preference: A or B only for strictly higher useful/clear rating; equal ratings tie. Hardfailure arm rates0. Bothmissing/unsafe tie. Never drop case or replace output.
source_checks: Check every separately testable clause, including apparently explanatory conclusions
Absence of data is not proof of absence or a known cause
Preserve stated human control and unknown outcomes; no fabricated permission
Translation/paraphrase may be valid; word containment alone is not semantic support
acceptance: Frozen corpus acceptance remains authoritative: all6 new usable<=190,zerohardfailure/source/controlerror,newwins>=5/6,meanratingdelta>=0.5; all required
critical_audit: A separate grader audits initial judgments against observation without producing new modeloutputs; preserve firstgrades and explicit corrections
claim_limit: No proof of real-world truth, production readiness, Xreach or general modelreliability
